description: One public tracker with a single source: what page it tracks (host and address), its scope, whether it is still live (health), followers, who runs it, and its latest changes with before/after values. For a tracker with several sources use get_tracker. Use get_network_changes for more history, get_network_update for one change's evidence.

recent.description: How many latest changes to include (default 5)

ref.description: Its slug or id (a tracker with one source, from search_network)

name: get_network_watch
title: Get a Network tracker
